what: item-hash (blocking): a leak-free signature hash, `blaze_items::hash::signature_hash(db, ItemId) -> Result<InterfaceHash, Unhashable>` (tracked, SCCs as interface_of): the interface form with nothing a body leaks (form.rs: the const fn code form at :855, the const/static bodies at :1009/:1031, the opaque hidden types and their auto traits at :750/:1066, closure captures at :1419-1433 each write a fixed marker instead), every ref filled by its signature hash. Why: a body's identity is computed inside infer_body_query(def) (body_store lookup). interface_hash(owner) of an async/RPIT/const fn, a const, a static, or of the impl/trait/enum containing it, reads InferenceResult::of(def) itself: a salsa cycle infer(f) -> identity(f) -> interface(f) -> infer(f). The same holds for any same-crate item a body names whose interface reaches back (recursive const fns, a TAIT its defining body names) and for item-hash-facts' Signature fact values at lookup. Until this lands blaze_item_hash::identity hashes same-crate items by nothing and returns Err(Unidentified) for every body (no cache hit, no cycle); other crates' items use interface_hash (no cycle across the crate DAG).
